set.body:
Scope

Promote the existing strong AR/censor unit behavior into a public end-to-end scenario.

Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The fixture contains at least two runs plus isolated and consecutive censored scans that form explicit whitening segments.
- [ ] A leakage canary places large values across run/censor boundaries and proves no AR state crosses those boundaries.
- [ ] Known-covariance GLS agrees with OLS on independently whitened L X and L Y.
- [ ] Fixed-AR results agree with an independent fmrireg/direct reference under exactly documented segment and initialization conventions.
- [ ] Estimated-AR coverage states and tests the selected estimation and pooling policy rather than treating another convention as a solver failure.
- [ ] Selected rows, run partitions, censor gaps, AR coefficients, whitening provenance, rank, df, coefficients, covariance, and T/F results are asserted.
- [ ] Complete and chunked multiresponse execution agree and reuse preparation according to the declared topology.
- [ ] Unsupported voxelwise/shared covariance combinations fail explicitly.
- [ ] The scenario returns clean Pass, has a reproducible receipt, and runs on JVM and Scala.js through public model/fit APIs.
set.title: P3.4: add a public run-and-censor-boundary AR/GLS scenario
